articles.title: Give up 125 units of free power: Bihar CM's appeal to affluent people, taxpayers
articles.summary: The state government spends around Rs 23,000 crore annually on power subsidies. Addressing the two-day Pataliputra National Youth Parliament-2. 0 in Patna, Choudhary urged affluent households to forgo the benefit and contribute towards Bihar 's development. The Bihar government provides 125 units of free electricity to consumers across economic categories.
articles.title_hi: 125 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली छोड़ें: बिहार के मुख्यमंत्री की संपन्न लोगों, करदाताओं से अपील
articles.summary_hi: राज्य सरकार बिजली सब्सिडी पर सालाना लगभग 23,000 करोड़ रुपये खर्च करती है। दो दिवसीय पाटलिपुत्र राष्ट्रीय युवा संसद-2 को संबोधित करते हुए। पटना में चौधरी ने संपन्न परिवारों से लाभ छोड़कर बिहार के विकास में योगदान देने का आग्रह किया। बिहार सरकार सभी आर्थिक श्रेणियों के उपभोक्ताओं को 125 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली प्रदान करती है।
articles.title_hinglish: 125 yunita muphta bijali chhodaेn: bihara ke mukhyamantri ki sanpanna logon, karadataon se apila
articles.summary_hinglish: rajya sarakara bijali sabsidi para salana lagabhaga 23,000 karoda rupaye kharcha karati hai। do divasiya pataliputra rashtriya yuva sansada-2 ko sanbodhita karate hue। patana men chaudhari ne sanpanna parivaron se labha chhodakara bihara ke vikasa men yogadana dene ka aagraha kiya। bihara sarakara sabhi aarthika shreniyon ke upabhoktaon ko 125 yunita muphta bijali pradana karati hai।

articles.title: Maoism-free Chhattisgarh now emerging as tourism and investment hub: Union minister
articles.summary: "There was a time when the mention of Chhattisgarh immediately brought Maoism to people's minds. Tourists did not visit this region. But today, as the state celebrates 'Rajyotsav', Chhattisgarh has been emerging as a tourism hub," Mandaviya said while addressing the inaugural ceremony of Rajyotsav-2026, Chhattisgarh's foundation day celebrations, in Nava Raipur.
articles.title_hi: माओवाद मुक्त छत्तीसगढ़ अब पर्यटन और निवेश केंद्र के रूप में उभर रहा है: केंद्रीय मंत्री
articles.summary_hi: मंडाविया ने नवा रायपुर में छत्तीसगढ़ के स्थापना दिवस समारोह, राज्योत्सव-2026 के उद्घाटन समारोह को संबोधित करते हुए कहा, "एक समय था जब छत्तीसगढ़ का जिक्र होते ही लोगों के मन में माओवाद आ जाता था। पर्यटक इस क्षेत्र में नहीं आते थे। लेकिन आज, जब राज्य 'राज्योत्सव' मना रहा है, छत्तीसगढ़ एक पर्यटन केंद्र के रूप में उभर रहा है।"
articles.title_hinglish: maovada mukta chhattisagadha aba paryatana aura nivesha kendra ke rupa men ubhara raha hai: kendriya mantri
articles.summary_hinglish: mandaviya ne nava rayapura men chhattisagadha ke sthapana divasa samaroh, rajyotsava-2026 ke udghatana samaroha ko sanbodhita karate hue kah, "eka samaya tha jaba chhattisagadha ka jikra hote hi logon ke mana men maovada aa jata tha। paryataka isa kshetra men nahin aate the। lekina aaj, jaba rajya 'rajyotsava' mana raha hai, chhattisagadha eka paryatana kendra ke rupa men ubhara raha hai।"

articles.title: 14-Year-Old Opposed His Mother’s Love Affair, Then His Body Was Found Near a Village
articles.summary: Published By: Sudeep Singh Rawat Last updated: Sun 2026-11-01 23:04 IST The murder of a 14-year-old boy in Bihar’s Bhojpur district has taken a shocking turn. Police have arrested his mother for allegedly conspiring with her lover to kill him. The boy reportedly opposed his mother’s relationship with the man.

articles.title: Haryana received Rs 2 lakh crore in central assistance under Modis leadership, says CM
articles.summary: The Chief Minister said Haryana's 2. 80 crore people were grateful for the Centre's financial support and development initiatives, particularly the expansion of national highways, expressways, railways, metro connectivity and other infrastructure. "Your guidance, cooperation and blessings will help Haryana achieve new heights of development," Saini wrote, expressing confidence that the state would continue to benefit from Modi's leadership.
articles.title_hi: सीएम ने कहा, मोदी के नेतृत्व में हरियाणा को केंद्रीय सहायता के तौर पर 2 लाख करोड़ रुपये मिले
articles.summary_hi: मुख्यमंत्री ने कहा कि हरियाणा के 2. 80 करोड़ लोग केंद्र की वित्तीय सहायता और विकास पहलों, विशेष रूप से राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों, एक्सप्रेसवे, रेलवे, मेट्रो कनेक्टिविटी और अन्य बुनियादी ढांचे के विस्तार के लिए आभारी हैं। सैनी ने लिखा, "आपका मार्गदर्शन, सहयोग और आशीर्वाद हरियाणा को विकास की नई ऊंचाइयों को हासिल करने में मदद करेगा।" उन्होंने विश्वास जताया कि राज्य को मोदी के नेतृत्व से लाभ मिलता रहेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: siema ne kah, modi ke netritva men hariyana ko kendriya sahayata ke taura para 2 lakha karoda rupaye mile
articles.summary_hinglish: mukhyamantri ne kaha ki hariyana ke 2. 80 karoda loga kendra ki vittiya sahayata aura vikasa pahalon, vishesha rupa se rashtriya rajamargon, eksapresave, relave, metro kanektiviti aura anya buniyadi dhanche ke vistara ke lie aabhari hain। saini ne likh, "aapaka margadarshan, sahayoga aura aashirvada hariyana ko vikasa ki naee oonchaiyon ko hasila karane men madada karega।" unhonne vishvasa jataya ki rajya ko modi ke netritva se labha milata rahega।

articles.title: UP Dalit student accuses two teachers of assault, caste slurs
articles.summary: Ghaziabad: A Grade 11 Dalit student in Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad has alleged that two teachers at a local government inter college physically assaulted him and hurled caste-based insults. The alleged incident occurred in Tyodhi 13 Biswa village at the Government Inter College within the jurisdiction of the Bhojpur police station.

articles.title_hinglish: yupi men dalita chhatra ne do shikshakon para lagaya marapita aura jatisuchaka shabda kahane ka aaropa
articles.summary_hinglish: gajiyabad: uttara pradesha ke gajiyabada men 11vin kaksha ke eka dalita chhatra ne aaropa lagaya hai ki eka sthaniya sarakari intara koleja men do shikshakon ne usake satha marapita ki aura jati aadharita apamana kiya। kathita ghatana bhojapura pulisa steshana ke adhikara kshetra men tyodhaी 13 bisva ganva ke sarakari intara koleja men huee।

articles.title: Dharmanagar’s Axiom Academy Adds Another Feather To Its Cap, Wins National-Level ‘Best
articles.summary: The prestigious joint ceremony of the ‘International Excellence Awards 2026’ and the ‘Global Icon Awards 2026’ was organised by Kiteskraft Productions LLP at Hotel Hometel, Janakpuri, New Delhi. The event witnessed the presence of distinguished personalities from India and abroad who have made remarkable contributions to education, entrepreneurship, diplomacy and social service.

articles.title: Indian opposition parties shift focus to defend the constitutional framework
articles.summary: Opposition parties in New Delhi are using protests against the electoral rolls revision to campaign for the protection of constitutional safeguards and democratic rights. Led by the Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance, politicians aim to challenge the government by defending institutional frameworks. The movement will face its next major electoral test during upcoming state assembly elections next year.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय विपक्षी दल संवैधानिक ढांचे की रक्षा पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर रहे हैं

articles.title_hinglish: bharatiya vipakshi dala sanvaidhanika dhanche ki raksha para dhyana kendrita kara rahe hain
articles.summary_hinglish: naee dilli men vipakshi dala sanvaidhanika suraksha upayon aura lokatantrika adhikaron ki suraksha ke lie abhiyana chalane ke lie matadata suchi sanshodhana ke khilapha virodha pradarshana ka upayoga kara rahe hain। bharatiya rashtriya vikasatmaka samaveshi gathabandhana ke netritva men, rajanetaon ka lakshya sansthagata dhanche ka bachava karake sarakara ko chunauti dena hai। agale sala aagami rajya vidhanasabha chunavon ke daurana aandolana ko apani agali badaी chunavi pariksha ka samana karana padaेga।

articles.title: Remove PM Modi To Save Democracy: Kharge Targets BJP, Election Commission At INDIA Bloc
articles.summary: Neither will our INDIA alliance leaders be scared. Everyone on this stage is ready to fight. Modi is trying to divide people and snatch their votes, choosing voters himself instead of letting people decide. The Central government and the governments in Maharashtra, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh have come to power through vote theft, and we must remove them.

articles.title: Rahul emerges as INDIA bloc's leading voice; Uttar Pradesh puts its resolve on trial
articles.summary: The Opposition had a spring in its step after the conclusion of its massive ‘Chalo Dilli’ rally against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at the historic Ramlila Maidan on Sunday. Whether or not Kumar departs, the protest has provided a springboard for the immediate task ahead: preventing a third consecutive mandate for the Lotus in Uttar Pradesh.

articles.title: Class VI student’s pregnancy exposes rape, FIR lodged
articles.summary: An alleged rape of a Class VI student came to light only after a medical examination at a Chandigarh hospital revealed that the minor was pregnant, exposing a crime that had reportedly remained hidden for months. Police said the girl was allegedly given a cold drink laced with alcohol before being sexually assaulted.

articles.title: Fragmented thought a new trend in politics, says JD-U's Neeraj Kumar on Independent MLCs
articles.summary: NDA allies BJP and JD-U had fielded four candidates each in the recently held MLC elections for eight seats in Bihar; however, the alliance could fetch just 3 seats while the rest of the Teachers’ and Graduates’ constituencies voted in favour of RJD, Independents, and newly founded Jan Suraaj Party (JSP).

articles.title: Thousands Protest in Delhi Over Alleged Rigging of Voter Rolls
articles.summary: Thousands rallied in Delhi demanding the election chief resign over disputed voter roll cuts. Critics claim minorities are disproportionately affected by the removal of millions of names. The government denies the allegations, stating ineligible voters are simply being removed. The growing demonstrations are becoming a major test of public trust in the national electoral system.
articles.title_hi: मतदाता सूची में कथित धांधली को लेकर दिल्ली में हजारों लोगों ने विरोध प्रदर्शन किया
articles.summary_hi: विवादित मतदाता सूची में कटौती पर चुनाव प्रमुख के इस्तीफे की मांग करते हुए हजारों लोगों ने दिल्ली में रैली की। आलोचकों का दावा है कि लाखों नाम हटा दिए जाने से अल्पसंख्यकों पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पड़ेगा। सरकार ने आरोपों से इनकार करते हुए कहा कि अयोग्य मतदाताओं को केवल हटाया जा रहा है। बढ़ते प्रदर्शन राष्ट्रीय चुनाव प्रणाली में जनता के भरोसे की एक बड़ी परीक्षा बन रहे हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: matadata suchi men kathita dhandhali ko lekara dilli men hajaron logon ne virodha pradarshana kiya

articles.title: Rajasthan raids net 22,000 litres of suspected adulterated ghee before Diwali, 3 held
articles.summary: More than 22,000 litres of suspected adulterated ghee worth about Rs 1. 60 crore were seized and three people arrested during raids on two firms in Rajasthan’s Sri Ganganagar district ahead of Diwali, police said. articles.title: Ramlila Maidan hosts united Opposition rally to challenge Bharatiya Janata Party
articles.summary: Twenty-one opposition parties gathered at Ramlila Maidan on Sunday to challenge the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party government. The historic Delhi ground previously hosted anti-corruption protests that helped bring down the Congress-led government in 2014. Leaders including Rahul Gandhi addressed the rally to unite opposition forces, protect democracy, and protest against government policies.

articles.title: Keralam marks seventy years of development alongside political and economic challenges
articles.summary: As Keralam marks seventy years since its formation, the state faces contradictions despite high literacy and public health investments. These challenges highlight the complex reality behind impressive human development indices.
